title: AlphaFold-based AI docking reveals AMPK/SIRT1-TFEB pathway modulation by traditional Chinese medicine in metabolic-associated fatty liver disease.
authors: Zhang, Lulu; Zheng, Yi; Shao, Mingyan; Chen, Aiping; Liu, Meiyi; Sun, Wenlong; Li, Tianxing; Fang, Yini; Dong, Yang; Zhao, Shipeng; Luo, Hui; Feng, Juan; Wang, Qi; Li, Lingru; Zheng, Yanfei
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold预测AMPK/SIRT1蛋白结构并进行分子对接，研究中药复方通过AMPK/SIRT1-TFEB通路调节自噬改善脂肪肝，但核心是蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅TFEB为转录因子但未涉及DNA结合，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Metabolic-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) is a chronic, progressive disorder characterized by hepatic steatosis and excessive lipid accumulation. Its high global adult prevalence (approximately 50.7 %) is a significant concern worldwide. However, FDA-approved therapeutic drugs remains lacking. Qigui Jiangzhi Formula (QGJZF) shows promise in treating MAFLD by effectively decreasing lipid levels and improving hepatic steatosis, however its mechanisms remain unclear. This study investigated QGJZF's effects in high-fat diet-induced zebrafish and golden hamsters, and in palmitate (PA) and oleic acid (OA) - induced HepG2 cells, using the SymMap database to identify potential targets and pathways of QGJZF in MAFLD and AlphaFold algorithms to predict protein structures. In vivo, QGJZF significantly alleviated hepatic lipid deposition. Intriguingly, QGJZF decreased lipid droplets and its levels are negative correlated with the numbers of autolysosomes, indicating that QGJZF's mechanism of ameliorating liver lipid deposition may be related to the regulation of autophagy. QGJZF upregulated the expressions of phosphorylated -Adenosine 5'-monophosphate (AMP) - activated protein kinase (p-AMPK), Sirtuin deacetylase 1 (SIRT1) and Transcription factor EB (TFEB), accompanied by the changes in autophagy-related proteins. In vitro, QGJZF inhibited the lipid deposition in PA/OA-stimulated HepG2 cells, and its effect was blocked by an autophagy inhibitor Baf-A1, which was mediated through upregulation of TFEB and its mediated autophagy-lysosomal pathway. Moreover, cotreatment with AMPK inhibitor Compound C, the regulation of QGJZF on TFEB, SIRT1, autophagy-related protein levels, and lipid deposition were reversed. Network pharmacology identified the PRKAA2 (AMPK) and SIRT1 as key hub targets. Futher analysis of their structures using AlphaFold3 algorithms, yielded high-ranking scores of 0.97 and 0.93, respectively. Liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry combined with molecular docking expounded its five compounds in QGJZF binding to AMPK protein. These findings suggest that QGJZF as a therapeutic agent in augmenting autophagy-facilitated lipid clearance for the management of MAFLD via AMPK/SIRT1-TFEB axis.
abstract_zh: 代谢相关脂肪性肝病（MAFLD）是一种以肝脂肪变性和脂质过度积累为特征的慢性进行性疾病。其全球成人患病率较高（约50.7%），引起全球广泛关注。然而，目前仍缺乏FDA批准的治疗药物。芪归降脂方（QGJZF）在治疗MAFLD方面显示出潜力，可有效降低脂质水平并改善肝脂肪变性，但其机制尚不清楚。本研究利用SymMap数据库识别QGJZF在MAFLD中的潜在靶点和通路，并采用AlphaFold算法预测蛋白质结构，探讨了QGJZF在高脂饮食诱导的斑马鱼和金仓鼠以及棕榈酸（PA）和油酸（OA）诱导的HepG2细胞中的作用。在体内实验中，QGJZF显著减轻了肝脏脂质沉积。有趣的是，QGJZF减少了脂滴，且其水平与自噬溶酶体数量呈负相关，表明QGJZF改善肝脏脂质沉积的机制可能与调节自噬有关。QGJZF上调了磷酸化腺苷一磷酸（AMP）活化蛋白激酶（p-AMPK）、去乙酰化酶Sirtuin 1（SIRT1）和转录因子EB（TFEB）的表达，并伴随自噬相关蛋白的变化。在体外实验中，QGJZF抑制了PA/OA刺激的HepG2细胞中的脂质沉积，其作用被自噬抑制剂Baf-A1阻断，该效应通过上调TFEB及其介导的自噬-溶酶体通路实现。此外，与AMPK抑制剂Compound C联合处理时，QGJZF对TFEB、SIRT1、自噬相关蛋白水平及脂质沉积的调节作用被逆转。网络药理学分析将PRKAA2（AMPK）和SIRT1识别为关键枢纽靶点。使用AlphaFold3算法对其结构进行进一步分析，分别获得了0.97和0.93的高排名评分。液相色谱-质谱联用结合分子对接阐明了QGJZF中五种化合物与AMPK蛋白的结合。这些发现表明，QGJZF作为治疗药物，通过AMPK/SIRT1-TFEB轴增强自噬介导的脂质清除，从而用于MAFLD的管理。
